name: Bounded Reflexivity
statement_plain: A carried self-audit claim whose subject and accepting instrument occupy the same level and which has no level-shift bridge is not accepted. For an audited repair claim with the supplied complete stack, non-saturation, FIII extension, and fresh-bridge certificates, the formal wrapper returns a linked fresh or rotating level; none is final. Its trigger premise is retained for statement fidelity rather than used to construct that level in the current Lean proof. Every finite tower whose declared capacity-measure record supplies the carrier-subset and disjoint-footprint algebra satisfies _ k<n c_k≤cap(Z). Consequently a finite E-system's self-model is scoped, non-final, and capacity-bounded; audit depth is a carried allocation problem.
statement_tex:
A carried self-audit claim whose subject and accepting instrument occupy the
same level and which has no level-shift bridge is not accepted.  For an
audited repair claim with the supplied complete stack, non-saturation, FIII
extension, and fresh-bridge certificates, the formal wrapper returns a linked
fresh or rotating level; none is final.  Its trigger premise is retained for
statement fidelity rather than used to construct that level in the current
Lean proof.  Every finite tower whose declared capacity-measure record
supplies the carrier-subset and disjoint-footprint algebra satisfies
\[
 \sum_{k<n}c_k\le\operatorname{cap}(Z).
\]
Consequently a finite E-system's self-model is scoped, non-final, and
capacity-bounded; audit depth is a carried allocation problem.

name: Self-Maintaining Reclosure
statement_plain: Persistence of an endogenous package has two separately typed stability conditions. In challenge-free operation they have the form E_t^2 E_t _ object-level closure , _ t+1 = m(z_t), d_ app ( _ t+1 , _t)≤ _ carried apparatus reinstatement and stability . Under challenge, the apparatus clause is replaced by a linked E1-style repair step. The formal maintained-closure wrapper takes a supplied carried status occurrence already tagged maintained\_closure, exact operator/reinstatement links, the maintained step, empty maintenance obstruction, no subsidy, and conditional regress-stop evidence; it packages the two-level certificate and maintained status. A complete classifier separately partitions that case from crystal-grade, subsidized, and decaying closure. The crystal-grade branch additionally requires object coherence, no accounting maintenance operator or reinstatement occurrence, no external reinstatement witness, stability, and no decay. Under persistent apparatus perturbation, a certified ablation of m and separating measured curves expose apparatus decay before the possibly slower decay of the existing object.
statement_tex:
Persistence of an endogenous package has two separately typed stability
conditions.  In challenge-free operation they have the form
\[
 \underbrace{E_t^2\simeq E_t}_{\text{object-level closure}},
 \qquad
 \underbrace{\App_{t+1}=\mathfrak m(z_t),\quad
 d_{\rm app}(\App_{t+1},\App_t)\le\varepsilon}
 _{\text{carried apparatus reinstatement and stability}}.
\]
Under challenge, the apparatus clause is replaced by a linked E1-style
repair step.  The formal maintained-closure wrapper takes a supplied carried
status occurrence already tagged \texttt{maintained\_closure}, exact
operator/reinstatement links, the maintained step, empty maintenance
obstruction, no subsidy, and conditional regress-stop evidence; it packages
the two-level certificate and maintained status.  A complete classifier
separately partitions that case from crystal-grade, subsidized, and decaying
closure.  The crystal-grade branch additionally requires object coherence,
no accounting maintenance operator or reinstatement occurrence, no external
reinstatement witness, stability, and no decay.  Under persistent apparatus
perturbation, a certified ablation of \(\mathfrak m\) and separating measured
curves expose apparatus decay before the possibly slower decay of the
existing object.

name: Repair Compilation
statement_plain: A lawful compilation candidate R≤adsto K_ ^ compiled requires a certified top-down channel, a passing memory-only comparator, saturation strictness, and a carried annotation or decompilation record. The compiled case additionally carries independent descent and post-compilation silence certificates. Within the trained class those certificates remove the per-episode repair demand: (Q_ ^ compiled ,F_ C ,r)= . Outside that class, a compiled gate can create split-pair obstructions that defeat descent on a supplied witness. The formal theorem makes no counterfactual claim that the formerly exposed repair would have statused or avoided them. Compilation may therefore trade recurrent audit cost for scope-dependent brittleness when the declared out-of-class witness is present.
statement_tex:
A lawful compilation candidate
\(R\leadsto K_{\ell}^{\rm compiled}\) requires a certified top-down channel,
a passing memory-only comparator, saturation strictness, and a carried
annotation or decompilation record.  The \texttt{compiled} case additionally
carries independent descent and post-compilation silence certificates.
Within the trained class those certificates remove the per-episode repair
demand:
\[
 \Delta(Q_{\ell}^{\rm compiled},F_{\mathcal C},r)=\varnothing.
\]
Outside that class, a compiled gate can create split-pair obstructions that
defeat descent on a supplied witness.  The formal theorem makes no
counterfactual claim that the formerly exposed repair would have statused or
avoided them.  Compilation may therefore trade recurrent audit cost for
scope-dependent brittleness when the declared out-of-class witness is
present.

name: Reclosure Collapse
statement_plain: An E-system is collapsed relative to C exactly when no move in the complete admissible carried inventory restores viability descent. It is irreversibly collapsed when, in addition, the repair generator is unreachable, the apparatus-level viability kernel is empty, and the reachability/kernel grades are certified coherent. An exhibited in-budget carried rescue move constructively falsifies collapse. A fully linked external repair in the absence of an in-budget descending internal rescue is classified as subsidy rather than self-maintenance, subject to the status priority; withdrawal of that subsidy may change status discontinuously.
statement_tex:
An E-system is collapsed relative to \(\mathcal C\) exactly when no move in
the complete admissible carried inventory restores viability descent.  It is
irreversibly collapsed when, in addition, the repair generator is
unreachable, the apparatus-level viability kernel is empty, and the
reachability/kernel grades are certified coherent.  An exhibited
in-budget carried rescue move constructively falsifies collapse.  A fully
linked external repair in the absence of an in-budget descending internal
rescue is classified as subsidy rather than self-maintenance, subject to the
status priority; withdrawal of that subsidy may change status discontinuously.

name: Attention
statement_plain: For a finite convex access host with positive costs, a supplied KKT witness, a binding exposure budget, and genuine scarcity, the certified optimal allocation has _ exp >0 : selected probes equalize marginal residual discharge per marginal cost at _ exp , while unselected probes do no better. Under slack, _ exp =0 .
statement_tex:
For a finite convex access host with positive costs, a supplied KKT witness,
a binding exposure budget, and genuine scarcity, the certified optimal
allocation has \(\lambda_{\rm exp}>0\): selected probes equalize marginal
residual discharge per marginal cost at
\(\lambda_{\rm exp}\), while unselected probes do no better.  Under slack,
\(\lambda_{\rm exp}=0\).

name: Alarm

Currentization is an alarm only when the constraint set changes; winning inside the old E6 policy is ordinary attention.

name: Cognitive Demarcation
statement_plain: Positive cognitive-package evidence is exactly repair descent, certified difference-making, and carried provenance for the same package/class claim. Under a complete status record, the package receives cognitive status only when that positive evidence is present and all six higher-priority raw evidence predicates are absent. A theorist-decodable package lacking difference-making is a correlate; absent carried provenance supplies scaffolding evidence. Neither receives cognitive status from readability alone.
statement_tex:

Under a complete status record, the package receives

all six higher-priority raw evidence predicates are absent.  A

The upper package has structural rewrite evidence when a certified top-down

 \operatorname{supp} K_\ell^{\Theta_i}\ne\operatorname{supp} K_\ell^{\Theta_j}

statement_plain: Given CompleteIndividuationStatus, exactly one of the six statuses below holds for a declared candidate. statement_tex:

\begin{align} 
 \mathsf{Repair}(I)&\subseteq I, & \mathsf{Budget}(I)&\subseteq I,\\
 \mathsf{Record}(I)&\subseteq I, &
 B(I)&\text{ is viability-sufficient and self-maintained}.

and no distinct overlapping maximal candidate exists.
The boundary is the coarsest admitted interface quotient through which all

Overlapping maximal candidates are classified as federated rather than

name: Repair Transport
cluster: C — Stack Rewrite, Individuation, and Repair Transport
statement_plain: Four related positive evidence forms hold. Communication evidence requires s to induce a paid, interface-mediated, role-preserving carried receiver repair with strict same-class delta reduction. Teaching evidence adds repairs sourced from B 's own committed state in an A -absent capacity test. Coercion null is certified when the interaction is fully forced, the complete free-response census is empty, no B -committed transported repair exists, and the before/after obstruction is unchanged. Force and census emptiness alone do not derive the latter two facts. Symbolic-repair evidence requires the token to reactivate a carried, role-preserving, saturation-strict R across a declared family whose context list has at least two entries. The formal family has no no-duplicate field, so distinct contexts are not certified. Under the complete priority classifier, the corresponding status also negates every higher raw evidence predicate: communicated excludes coercion-null, symbolic, and taught evidence; taught excludes coercion-null and symbolic evidence; symbolic excludes coercion-null evidence. The four named Lean theorems package supplied full cases; they do not derive status from the positive structure alone.
statement_tex:
Four related positive evidence forms hold.
\begin{enumerate}
  \item Communication evidence requires \(s\) to induce a
  paid, interface-mediated, role-preserving carried receiver repair with
  strict same-class delta reduction.
  \item Teaching evidence adds repairs sourced from \(B\)'s own committed
  state in an \(A\)-absent capacity test.
  \item Coercion null is certified when the interaction is fully forced, the
  complete free-response census is empty, no \(B\)-committed transported
  repair exists, and the before/after obstruction is unchanged.  Force and
  census emptiness alone do not derive the latter two facts.
  \item Symbolic-repair evidence requires the token to reactivate a
  carried, role-preserving, saturation-strict \(R\) across a declared family
  whose context list has at least two entries.  The formal family has no
  no-duplicate field, so distinct contexts are not certified.
\end{enumerate}
Under the complete priority classifier, the corresponding status also
negates every higher raw evidence predicate: communicated excludes
coercion-null, symbolic, and taught evidence; taught excludes coercion-null
and symbolic evidence; symbolic excludes coercion-null evidence.  The four
named Lean theorems package supplied full cases; they do not derive status
from the positive structure alone.

name: Reconsolidation
cluster: D — Carried Memory and Adaptive Capacity
statement_plain: For a carried retrieval conflict with F9 coverage, after provenance defect, silent rewrite, ordinary-read, outcome-collision, and unrealized-disposition evidence have been excluded, exactly one lawful substantive disposition occurs: &InstallsRecordJoin(m_t,R_c,m_ t+1 ), &&or\\ &Refines(q^-,q^+) \ \ x,x':\ q^+(x)=q^+(x') q^-(x) q^-(x'), &&or\\ &m_ t+1 =m_t with a statused residual charged to _S. The first is record repair, the second a strict loss of a distinction no longer supportable under the declared futures, and the third retained debt. A same-identity, same-claim record with changed value is an unlawful silent rewrite only when no lawful reconsolidation outcome exists, no typed F9 disposition exists, and the complete mutation-provenance inventory is empty.
statement_tex:
For a carried retrieval conflict with F9 coverage, after provenance defect,
silent rewrite, ordinary-read, outcome-collision, and unrealized-disposition
evidence have been excluded, exactly one lawful substantive disposition
occurs:
\begin{equation} 
\begin{aligned}
&\mathsf{InstallsRecordJoin}(m_t,R_c,m_{t+1}), &&\text{or}\\
&\mathsf{Refines}(q^-,q^+)
 \ \land\
 \exists x,x':\
 q^+(x)=q^+(x')\land q^-(x)\ne q^-(x'), &&\text{or}\\
&m_{t+1}=m_t
\text{ with a statused residual charged to }\Lambda_S.
\end{aligned}
\end{equation}
The first is record repair, the second a strict loss of a distinction no
longer supportable under the declared futures, and the third retained debt.
A same-identity, same-claim record with changed value is an unlawful silent
rewrite only when no lawful reconsolidation outcome exists, no typed F9
disposition exists, and the complete mutation-provenance inventory is empty.

name: Offline Reclosure
cluster: D — Carried Memory and Adaptive Capacity
statement_plain: Given complete carried debt, phase-flow, budget, and status records, exactly one E15 status in holds. The alternation\_required case verifies strict online deficit and a recurrent lawful offline substrate: external exchange is gated to zero, the exact freed allocation is assigned to internal transport or repackaging, and linked debt discharge occurs during each credited phase. It additionally carries a duty-cycle prediction, a tolerance declared before the horizon, and d_ obs -d_ pred within that tolerance. If a≤ _ on , the claim lies outside the strict-deficit necessity argument; formal no-requirement follows only from a supplied complete OnlineSufficientCase, not from that scalar inequality alone. The status named skipped\_offline\_cascade is an all-online strict-deficit, debt-growth cascade with timed E7 alarm and later E5-stressed observations; it does not itself prove that a separately scheduled offline phase was skipped.
statement_tex:
Given complete carried debt, phase-flow, budget, and status records, exactly
one E15 status in \cref{tab:e15-status} holds.  The
\texttt{alternation\_required} case verifies strict online deficit and a
recurrent lawful offline substrate: external exchange is gated to zero, the
exact freed allocation is assigned to internal transport or repackaging, and
linked debt discharge occurs during each credited phase.  It additionally
carries a duty-cycle prediction, a tolerance declared before the horizon,
and \(\lvert d_{\rm obs}-d_{\rm pred}\rvert\) within that tolerance.  If
\(a\le\kappa_{\rm on}\), the claim lies outside the strict-deficit necessity
argument; formal no-requirement follows only from a supplied complete
\texttt{OnlineSufficientCase}, not from that scalar inequality alone.  The status named
\texttt{skipped\_offline\_cascade} is an all-online strict-deficit,
debt-growth cascade with timed E7 alarm and later E5-stressed observations;
it does not itself prove that a separately scheduled offline phase was
skipped.

name: Adaptability
cluster: D — Carried Memory and Adaptive Capacity
statement_plain: An E-system exhibits coherent adaptability exactly when the two routes are currently indistinguishable but leave a claim-linked difference in held-out repair-capacity distributions that survives all declared controls and is not already an outstanding E15 residue. Such a record has two consequences: the endpoints satisfy the exact CurrentEventEquiv relation; and the exact claim-linked records report unequal future repair probabilities despite matched current endpoints. A currentizable residue is legible slack, not adaptability; a residue erased by lawful continuation is dissipative memory; an equal claim-linked pair is flat.
statement_tex:
An E-system exhibits coherent adaptability exactly when the two routes are
currently indistinguishable but leave a claim-linked difference in held-out
repair-capacity distributions that survives all declared controls and is not
already an outstanding E15 residue.  Such a record has two consequences:
\begin{enumerate}
  \item the endpoints satisfy the exact
  \(\mathsf{CurrentEventEquiv}\) relation; and
  \item the exact claim-linked records report unequal future repair
  probabilities despite matched current endpoints.
\end{enumerate}
A currentizable residue is legible slack, not adaptability; a residue erased
by lawful continuation is dissipative memory; an equal claim-linked pair is
flat.
